category: crypto market data API (tickers, coins, exchanges, OHLCV)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 20,000 calls a month per IP, 2,000 assets, 1 year of daily prices, no key, no account, no card; 10 requests a second per IP
free_tier.notes: The free host is api.coinpaprika.com/v1; paid plans use api-pro.coinpaprika.com with a key. Free updates arrive within 10 minutes; intraday history is hourly for the last 24 hours and OHLCV is the latest full day. The first paid plan is Starter at USD 99 a month for 400,000 calls.

retention.notes: History: 1 year of daily prices on Free; full history on Pro and above.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 20,000 calls a month bound what one IP can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.coinpaprika.com/v1/... with no key; paid plans send the key as the bare Authorization header value to api-pro.coinpaprika.com
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; official Go, PHP, Python, TypeScript, Swift and Kotlin clients exist
chaining: Keyless crypto prices for a year of daily history; it pairs with a macro source such as FRED when a model mixes asset classes.

limits.value: 20,000 calls a month per IP on the Free plan
10 requests a second per IP on every plan

limits_note: Bulk path: none stated on the pricing page; redistribution needs the Enterprise plan. Storage terms: the API terms page captured as an empty shell, so unverified.
binding_note: 20,000 calls a month is spent in about 33 minutes at 10 requests a second, so the monthly count binds first.

identity_cost.detail: The Free plan needs no key, no account and no card: the pricing page says so and a keyless call answered HTTP 200.

reliability_note: Past a limit the API answers 429 or 402 with a message naming the limit.
confidence_note: A keyless ticker call answered HTTP 200; the limits are documented on the pricing page, which was reviewed by the vendor on 2026-10-27.
